g.text: PMIC - nPM2100 (battery power / switched FDC rail)

g.desc: PMIC - nPM2100 (battery power / switched FDC rail)

g.text: XL1 = pad 25; XL2 = pad 24. Internal LFXO load bank; tune on hardware.

g.desc: XL1 = pad 25; XL2 = pad 24. Internal LFXO load bank; tune on hardware.

g.text: INPUT PROTECTION: PMOS reverse battery; ESD clamps + series isolation.

g.desc: INPUT PROTECTION: PMOS reverse battery; ESD clamps + series isolation.

g.text: No sustained overvoltage cutoff or battery fuse. Prototype ESD / leakage / sensing qualification required.

g.desc: No sustained overvoltage cutoff or battery fuse. Prototype ESD / leakage / sensing qualification required.

g.text: C3 is 0603, 10uF/16V X6S. Verify VDD ripple <=10mV during radio.

g.desc: C3 is 0603, 10uF/16V X6S. Verify VDD ripple <=10mV during radio.

g.text: External: C3 10uF mandatory; X1 retained for timed System OFF wake.

g.desc: External: C3 10uF mandatory; X1 retained for timed System OFF wake.

g.text: Internal: 32 MHz crystal, DCDC support and RF matching/antenna.

g.desc: Internal: 32 MHz crystal, DCDC support and RF matching/antenna.
